Indian Army begins raising Integrated Battle Groups along China border

The Indian Army has commenced the establishment of Integrated Battle Groups (IBGs), a new combat formation. The initial rollout focuses on the 17 Mountain Strike Corps, with five IBGs being raised along the border with China. This initiative is seen as a significant step in modernizing the army's operational capabilities.
